messages:
matt_devex: FYI I'm planning the Py/TS SDK publish for v1.14.0 tomorrow in the 11:00 PT change window. Canary -> staggered rollout -> GA. Also adding a deprecation notice for the legacy sync client (90d). Want quick ack and any last-minute blockers.

sophia_eng: ack. what's the canary tag and publish order? will we push the docs simultaneously?

matt_devex: canary tag = `canary-1.14.0` for both registries. Order: publish TS canary first (npm), wait 15m for telemetry, then Py canary (pip). If all green, promote npm -> latest and Py -> latest over next hour. docs push at GA only unless something small needs early note.

raj_release: -> added to release checklist. Rollback plan: if canary errors >= 5% 5xx or install regressions reported, we'll yank canary tag and revert the package on npm, and rollback Py by uploading a yanked wheel and pin CI to previous release. Need exact commands in the thread.

cli-publisher: npm canary publish command: `yarn build && npm publish --tag canary-1.14.0` Py canary (testpypi): `python -m build && twine upload --repository testpypi dist/* -u __token__ -p $TEST_PYPI_TOKEN`. GA to Py: `twine upload dist/*` to pypi. For rollback: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/inference latest` and `npm dist-tag add @redwood/inference 1.13.3 latest` or publish a patch with revert.

jen_support: heads-up for support docs. I'll draft a KB note that sync client is deprecated; need the exact deprecation text and timeline. Also confirm if we should add a banner in Console about upcoming deprecation.

matt_devex: deprecation blurb: "The legacy sync client is deprecated and will be removed on YYYY-MM-DD (90 days). Migrate to the async client or official SDK; see migration guide at https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/migrate-sync-to-async". Put YYYY-MM-DD = 2026-06-30 in the announcement. Yes, add a Console banner on GA day.

sophia_eng: quick regression checklist for canary monitoring: install counts, first-time initialization logs, unit/e2e smoke runs in CI (pin to canary), and watch telemetry errors. I'll run smoke e2e against canary in staging immediately after publish.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Publishing canary package to npm (tag: canary-1.14.0) by cli-publisher at 1768348000

cli-publisher: canary npm publish completed, tarball sha: sha256:3b2f... Waiting 15m for telemetry.

sophia_eng: started smoke e2e against canary. hitting minor schema warning in chat message marshalling (non-blocker).

jen_support: KB draft link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/KB/Deprecate+legacy+sync+client - put review comments there. Will schedule outgoing email on GA day.

matt_devex: Py canary upload to testpypi in 5m. tag and wheel uploaded.

cli-publisher: Py testpypi upload done at 1768348500. Test installs succeeded in ephemeral env: `pip install --index-url https://test.pypi.org/simple/ redwood-inference==1.14.0rc1` ; ran basic smoke import.

sophia_eng: telemetry: error rate trending 0.2% normal. keep watching.

raj_release: decision matrix for rollback: if install failures >= 3% across regions OR top-level API errors increase by >1% absolute and don't recover in 10m -> rollback. Otherwise proceed to GA after 60m observation.

matt_devex: agreed. any docs changes outstanding?

jen_support: migration guide needs one additional snippet for auth token behavior. I'll add and ping docs owner.

sophia_eng: after 60m observation with no regressions, I'll approve promote to GA for TS then Py. Can someone handle npm tag promote automation?

cli-publisher: I can run promote: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/inference@1.14.0 latest` then `npm publish --tag latest` if needed. Py GA: build artifacts and `twine upload` to pypi, ensure CHANGES.md updated.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary observation window complete at 1768349000. Error rate: 0.25% (within threshold). No install regressions reported in 60m.

sophia_eng: approving GA promote for npm.

cli-publisher: promoted npm to latest at 1768349050. changelog PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512

matt_devex: starting Py GA publish now. remember to update pip classifiers and docs redirect.

cli-publisher: Py GA upload complete at 1768349150. Released 1.14.0 to pypi. Release notes published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/releases/tag/v1.14.0

jen_support: Console banner created and KB published. Email scheduled for 2026-06-30 to go out to active SDK users. Support oncall loop added.

sophia_eng: small post-release smoke in prod — all good. watching memory usage for a few hours.

raj_release: closing the change window. tagging release in internal tracker. Remember to schedule the deprecation pipeline to add `@deprecated` notices in the SDK docs and a compatibility shim issue for teams who can't migrate.

matt_devex: thanks all. follow-up items: 1) docs migration snippet (jen), 2) add deprecation banner on docs (docs team), 3) telemetry dashboard card for legacy sync deprecation (sophia), 4) record rollback playbook in runbook (raj). I'll file tasks.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Change window closed at 1768349199. All steps completed successfully. :tada:
